fields.statement: Verified at eee7eb49d (attempt 2). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipGateFullLog|TestShipRebase' -count=1: all PASS. TestShipGateFullLog runs a gate printing '--- FAIL: TestX' first, 20000 filler lines (>64 KB) and make's 'Error 1' last: the log file holds every byte, ShipGateResponse.Log names it, and the last 20 human lines contain '--- FAIL: TestX' and the log path; its passing subtest shows a passing gate writes the log too. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: TestShipRebaseRunsLocalGate's failing case now asserts r.Gate.Log is <common>/rhiza/gate/cs/ship-it.log, the file holds the whole output, and the human output has 'Full log: <path>' (shared path through shipLocalGate, ship_rebase.go). Diff read: shipWriteGateLog writes atomically under the common dir, shipGateFailLines keeps at most 10 --- FAIL/FAIL/panic: lines printed before 'Full log:'. describe-golden has the log field and TestScripts/describe-golden passes. grep -c 'run `rhiza ship gate` to see' prints 0 for ship-change.toml and docs.toml; both gate-fix prompts in each name `rhiza run status --json` and the full gate log. make self-check passes (exit 0) from a clean detached worktree of eee7eb49d with the run's RHIZA_* env unset (with it set, it fails only on the verifier sessions' own unrendered actor files).
